user.title: Connect SG Fleet Novated Leasing (mySG)
user.description: Choose how to authenticate with your SG Fleet mySG account.

credentials.title: Sign in to SG Fleet mySG
credentials.description: Enter your mySG email address and password. If your account uses MFA or Auth0 presents a CAPTCHA, setup will automatically switch to Browser Sign-In.

browser_pkce.title: Browser Sign-In (PKCE)
browser_pkce.description:
1. Open this SG Fleet sign-in link in your browser:

{auth_url}

2. Sign in to mySG (including any MFA or CAPTCHA).
3. After sign-in, copy the full redirected URL (`https://mysg.sgfleet.com/?code=...&state=...`) from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SG Fleet mySG
reauth_confirm.description: Your SG Fleet session has expired. Choose how you would like to sign back in.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to SG Fleet. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials or sign in via Browser Sign-In.
error.invalid_callback: Could not extract a valid authorization code from the pasted URL.
error.captcha_required: Auth0 requested a CAPTCHA challenge. Please complete sign-in in your browser and paste the redirected URL below.
error.mfa_required: Multi-factor authentication is required. Please complete sign-in in your browser and paste the redirected URL below.
error.unknown: Unexpected error communicating with SG Fleet.

abort.already_configured: This SG Fleet account is already configured.

init.title: SG Fleet Integration Options
init.description: Configure independent update intervals per data tier (with automatic ±15% jitter) and active polling hours to keep SG Fleet traffic low-profile.

data.reimbursements_smart_mode: Smart Reimbursements Mode (slow down to Balances interval when no claims are pending)
data.active_hours_enabled: Restrict Scheduled Polling to Active Hours
data.linked_vehicle_device_id: Linked Vehicle Device (links SG Fleet lease CI to your car integration)
data.odometer_entity_id: Linked Odometer Sensor (optional — auto-detected from linked vehicle if left blank)
